The '''concessions concourse''' was a disc-shaped building in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. Located on the cliff above the amphitheatre used for the arena, it consisted of two stories and a tower, with debtors cells built beneath the structure. Fans entering the arena were encouraged to visit the concourses, where they could place bets, purchase souvenirs, visit exhibitions, or test drive scaled down [[podracer]]s, in rooms such as the [[Gambling Hall]], [[Trophy Room]], [[history of podracing exhibition]], and [[Bo Charmian Racing School/Canon|Bo Charmian Racing School]].

==Description==
The concession concourses was a [[Color|gray]], disc-shaped building that was a part of the [[podracing]] [[Mos Espa Grand Arena|Grand Arena]] in the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The structure sat directly behind the [[arena citadel]] on top of the cliff overlooking the natural ampitheatre in which the arena was built. A small dome sat on top of the flat, circular roof of the concessions concourses and a second dome with a tower rising from it was built on the edge of the roof.<ref name="CL" />

The main concession concourses structure consisted of two stories, with a [[Gambling Hall]] located in a room curved along atleast a quarter of the outside wall of the second story, with a room split by a mezzanine floor adjacent to the hall toward the center of the building. The lower floor of this room was used as a race viewing gallery with large screens, while the mezzanine housed the [[history of podracing exhibition]].<ref name="CL" />

On the lower floor of the concessions concourse, the [[Bo Charmian Racing School/Canon|Bo Charmian Racing School]] was located in an arched room that ran along the outer wall beneath the Gambling Hall. An arched [[Trophy Room]] was located beside it toward the center of the building, with steps leading down to holding cells used for debtors benath the building. The tower that rose from the concessions concourses was atleast three stories tall and contained the [[Grand Stairway]] running up over atleast three floors and a series of private deal-making rooms on the highest floor.<ref name="CL" />

==History==
The concessions concourses was in use by the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace held<ref name="CL" /> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> At that [[time]], the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] controlled [[Gambling|betting]] at the arena, and once fans had made their way inside, Hutt-controlled managers would "urge" them to visit the concourses. Customers in the building could place bets, purchase souvenirs, visit exhibitions, or test drive scaled down [[podracer]]s, with many would be [[Podracer (profession)|podracers]] getting their first taste for the profession within the concourses, often while smashing up stalls and exhibits in the process. During the Boonta Eve Classic, a large number of individuals spent time inside the concessions concourses, with a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] and a [[speeder]] parked on the roof of the building.<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The concessions concourses first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], it was identified in the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]. The identification was part of material reprinted<ref name="CL" /> from the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]], illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]], and marked the first identification of the [[Concessions concourses/Legends|building]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>
